scenes.narration: Netflix made thirty-nine billion dollars in 2024. Almost all of it came from one simple idea.
By the end of 2024, Netflix had more than three hundred million paid memberships.
The model is a loop. You pay every month. Netflix spends that money on new shows. And new shows keep you watching, and bring in new members.
And the loop keeps growing. Revenue went from twenty-five billion dollars in 2020 to thirty-nine billion in 2024.
In 2022, Netflix added a cheaper plan with ads. You pay less, and advertisers pay the difference.

props.verdict: More people can afford to join

scenes.narration: So Netflix wins three ways. Payments repeat every month. Its own shows give people a reason to stay. And ads bring in viewers who would not pay full price.

items.text: Own shows give a reason to stay
Ads bring in viewers who won't pay full price

scenes.narration: Next time you press play, remember: you are the business model.
